thesis: Perseverance costs something before it stays.
captions: Perseverance never shows up as one big speech
It's just these untied shoes, laced again anyway
So I stopped waiting for a burst of will
Because the cost comes first, every single morning
My hands tie the same knot, half asleep
Yet nothing dramatic happened on any given day
The doing became the only proof that counted
Although some mornings the laces felt impossible today
The shoes stayed tied longer than the doubt did

thesis: Belonging costs something before it stays.
captions: Belonging waits in the kitchen doorway, arms crossed.
It watches the drink I poured but haven't touched.
So it studies whether I'll walk further inside.
Although the room is loud, it makes me hesitate.
Because it needs proof before handing a seat.
Yet it lingers near my hand, patient, unclaimed.
The ice melts while I decide to move.
I finally cross the room and the doorway empties.
The drink is warm now, and finally, mine.

thesis: Communication costs something before it stays.

anchor.name: empty passenger seat of a car

captions: Nobody tells you the words don't just leave you
This seat stayed empty long after you stopped talking
At first every silence cost me my whole evening
I thought saying nothing meant nothing had to change
So I kept driving with the seat beside me
But the cost didn't vanish, it just moved seats
Now the quiet rides shotgun instead of blocking me
I speak first now, because waiting always cost more
The seat sits empty, but I keep it open

thesis: Vulnerability costs something before it stays.
captions: The towel slipped from my hands before I decided
I let it lie there instead of grabbing
Picking it up costs less than speaking next
Because saying the true thing means they can refuse
So I stood in the kitchen, hands empty, exposed
Yet nobody made me stay that open on purpose
Staying open isn't the same as staying unguarded forever
It meant choosing the risk after it cost me
I bent down, lifted the towel, and stayed anyway

thesis: Regret costs something before it stays.
captions: The letter's still folded, still on the desk tonight
You paid something the moment you sealed it shut
Not sending it felt like keeping a door closed
Sending it might have cost you the whole room
So the folded letter stayed cheaper than the truth
But cheap isn't the same as free, is it
Every night it sits there, the cost keeps compounding
You call that saving yourself, or delaying the bill
So which was that letter, mercy or unpaid debt
